title: Reason out CCP congestion policy
description: User requests static reasoning for the Probably Right Thing for CCP density/congestion behavior. Derive a minimal receiver-aware policy that separates link budget, rendezvous and offered airtime, with numerical sanity checks. Analysis only: no code, fixture or specification changes; proposed policy is not an adjudicated decision.
design: Use independent bounded reviews of single-radio rendezvous and airtime/congestion, check representative airtime arithmetic, and synthesize a proposal with explicit assumptions, rejected alternatives and measurement-dependent parameters. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing and best-effort custody decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation addresses density-driven CH0/SF coupling, receiver and half-duplex constraints, legal airtime groups, weak-signal versus congestion evidence, bounded queues and control-plane preservation. Static conclusions separated from tuning and runtime claims; findings retained in Beads without changing the spec.
